instruction: USB 2.0 Length Matching The file `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb` has USB 2.0 D+ (`USB_DP`) and D- (`USB_DM`) routed on F.Cu at 0.15 mm width. Their lengths differ by approximately 1 mm, exceeding the USB 2.0 intra-pair skew budget. Add a meander on the shorter differential net (D-) until `|L(USB_DP) - L(USB_DM)| <= 0.15 mm`. Preserve layer assignments (F.Cu only), track widths (0.15 mm), and introduce no new vias. Requirements: 1. `|L(USB_DP) - L(USB_DM)| <= 0.15 mm`. 2. Both nets have segments only on F.Cu; no layer changes. 3. All `USB_DP` and `USB_DM` segment widths remain 0.15 mm. 4. No new vias added on `USB_DP` or `USB_DM` vs the input. 5. `USB_DM` has more segments than the input (meander increases segment count). 6. Also write `/home/user/Desktop/fcu.svg` as the native KiCad CLI F.Cu SVG export of your final board. Write /home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb and /home/user/Desktop/fcu.svg. [Software] To use KiCad, run `kicad` for the GUI or `kicad-cli` for scripting/headless use (use PATH or the full install path).
